sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's new National Electricity Plan (RUPTL) targets 23% renewable mix by 2025, driving capex for geothermal and hydropower developers like Medco and PLN.
Carbon tax implementation in 2025 will create a price floor for RECs (Renewable Energy Certificates), benefiting pure-play IPPs with existing green capacity.
US utility outperformance suggests global rate-cut expectations are lifting renewables valuations, a sentiment tailwind for Indonesia's dollar-denominated project financing.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables sector underperformed today, but US utility gains signal defensive rotation. Watch for policy catalysts like the new RUPTL (electricity plan) and carbon tax implementation, which could re-rate Indonesian names. Near-term, focus on ADRO and Medco's geothermal spin-off as liquidity improves.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Rising middle-class disposable income in Java and Sumatra is structurally boosting demand for premium FMCG products, favoring brands with strong distribution networks.
Government push for downstreaming and local content requirements is creating durable cost advantages for domestic manufacturers over imported goods.
Digital penetration in rural Indonesia is unlocking new consumption channels for FMCG players, with e-commerce and social commerce growing faster than traditional retail.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's consumer sector underperformed today (-1.60% ID vs +1.48% US), but selective names surged on idiosyncratic catalysts—AGAR +24.75% and KLIN +10% lead. Watch for rotation into defensive staples as rate uncertainty persists; focus on cash-rich, dividend-yielding names like TFCO and SOSS for near-term resilience.
